description: This file defines the ArrayExpression class which extends AbstractExpression. It manages array elements, including adding, checking, and compiling array expressions in the Twig templating engine. It handles key-value pairs, spread operators, and array merging logic.

classes.name: ArrayExpression
classes.description: Represents an array expression node in Twig, managing array elements, key-value pairs, and the compilation process for rendering array structures within templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArrayExpression with elements and line number, setting up key indexing based on existing key-value pairs.

methods.name: getKeyValuePairs
methods.description: Returns the array elements as key-value pairs extracted from internal nodes.

methods.name: hasElement
methods.description: Checks if a given key exists within the array elements.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element to the array, optionally with a specified key.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the array expression into PHP code for rendering, handling spread operators and array merging.

methods.name: hasSpreadItem
methods.description: Determines if any array element uses the spread operator, influencing merge behavior.
